sample.topic: Should communities reduce their use of single-use plastics?
sample.introduction: Single-use plastics are everywhere in our communities. Communities should reduce their use of these plastics because they can pollute rivers and harm animals.
sample.body:
Communities can reduce single-use plastics by carrying reusable bags. Reusable bags reduce waste in rivers.

Plastic containers harm animals. Communities can protect animals by using reusable containers.
sample.conclusion: In conclusion, communities should reduce single-use plastics. Reusable bags and containers can protect rivers and animals.
